name: Boku to Kare no Kiken na Doukyo Seikatsu
original_name: 僕と彼の危険な同居生活
source:
In this big city, New York.

An international student, Hinata is in a fix. He was going to enter the university that day, but he was rejected by the incomprehensible reason. Moreover, he found himself to be wanted by the police as an illegal immigrant.

He winds up in a house share run by "Allen", but all his roommates seem very peculiar... 

There is the university student "Allen", the manager of the shared house, who secretly makes a living as an assassin.

There is the cool guy "Brad", a member of the "66" gang. 

And then, there is the suspicious and charming Mr Mysterious "Chad". Apparently, he is a professional trickster!?

Falling in love, Hinata finds himself torn between romance and intrigue.

Will he choose love in the end? Or he…

[From [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=912279494]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
translation:
这里是大城市纽约。

留学生日向陷入了困境。他原本打算当天进入大学，却因为莫名其妙的理由被拒绝入学。更糟的是，他还被警方列为非法移民通缉对象。

他最后住进了由“艾伦”经营的合租屋，但所有室友似乎都十分古怪……

大学生“艾伦”是合租屋的管理者，暗中以杀手为生。

冷酷的“布拉德”是“66”帮的一员。

还有可疑又迷人的神秘先生“查德”。据说，他是个职业骗子！？

坠入爱河的日向，在恋情与阴谋之间痛苦挣扎。

他最终会选择爱情吗？还是会……

[来源：[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=912279494]Steam Greenlight[/url]]
